These fixture CSVs are excerpts of UCI Machine Learning Repository datasets,
licensed CC BY 4.0 (see `LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`).

- `uci_forest_fires_sample.csv`: P. Cortez and A. Morais, "Forest Fires",
  https://doi.org/10.24432/C5D88D. Source lines 140-173 of
  https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/forest-fires/forestfires.csv,
  with the header.
- `uci_algerian_forest_fires_sample.csv`: F. Abid, "Algerian Forest Fires",
  https://doi.org/10.24432/C5KW4N. Lines 1-32 (the Bejaia region) of
  https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/00547/Algerian_forest_fires_dataset_UPDATE.csv.
  The loader skips the "Bejaia Region Dataset" title line.
